newsitem.title: HONG KONG: MasterCard, Hongkong Bank forms Mondex JV.
newsitem.headline: MasterCard, Hongkong Bank forms Mondex JV.

text.p: MasterCard International and The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp Ltd said on Thursday they will form a joint venture to market, develop Mondex in 13 Asian territories where Hongkong Bank owns Mondex franchise rights.
Pending final approval of directors of both companies, MasterCard would be the managing partner with a 51 percent stake in the joint venture, MasterCard said in a statement.
The joint venture would also manage the implementation of the Mondex technology to allow financial institutions in Asia to issue Mondex chip cards to customers, it said.
UK-based Mondex International makes a payment card embedded with a computer chip. The cards are commonly referred to as smart cards.
On Monday, MasterCard completed its acquisition of a 51 percent stake in Mondex International, which makes Mondex a subsidiary of MasterCard.

Mondex is well established in Hong Kong and the joint venture would accelerate development and use of Mondex in Brunei, China, India, Indonesia, Macau, Malaysia, Mauritius, the Philippines, Singapore, Sri Lanka, Taiwan and Thailand.

The statement said industry experts estimate more than 85 percent of all transactions in these Asian markets involve cash and Mondex is expected to significantly reduce dependence on cash for everyday payments.
